services.desc: Five days and Five Nights of riding and camping along the trail. Moving our herd of horses and mules. Five days and Five Nights of riding and camping along the trail. Moving our herd of horses and mules. Come be part of history and saddle up with Mammoth Lakes Pack Outfit on a fast-paced and exciting tradition...the Historical Mammoth Lakes Pack Outfit Horse Drive! On this "old-time" working trail drive, we move our herd of horses and mules between our winter pastures in the Owens Valley and our summer headquarters located in Mammoth Lakes, CA. Traveling along the same trails that were used by horsemen and cowboys of the past, you are sure to find adventure around every bend and live part

blurb: We are a full service pack station located in the Eastern Sierra Nevada Mountains outside of the town of Mammoth Lakes, California. We offer an array of services including all-inclusive and customized pack trips, horseback vacations, seasonal horse drives, and the areas best daily horseback and mule trail rides.
